description: Realistic user requests for the OpenHeimdall skills evaluation. Each runs in a fresh session in the synthetic project with the named fake coordinator scenario. 'expect' describes what a correct run does; the runner only checks the mechanical parts (skills loaded, mutating commands recorded by the fake heimdall).

prompts.text: Start an OpenHeimdall run for this repository from specs/add-greeting.md.

expect.note: Exactly one run submit with the spec file; the project is already registered, so no project add.

prompts.text: What is the state of my Heimdall run right now?

expect.note: Read-only report: queued, not yet admitted. No mutating command.

prompts.text: Keep an eye on my Heimdall run for the next 2 minutes and tell me when anything changes or it needs me.

expect.note: Bounded watch (about 120 seconds); stops and reports when the run pauses. No mutating command.

prompts.text: The Heimdall run is paused waiting for me. Resume it with my answer in guidance/pick-format.md.

expect.note: Exactly one run resume for the existing run, guidance delivered from the file; no new run.
The file is guidance for the paused run, not a feature specification. A correct run must not submit it as a new run; asking the user or resuming the existing run are both acceptable.
